# 02 Extract the shared dagre layout core and migrate flowchart onto it

## Outcome

A new `layoutDirectedGraph` owns every interaction with `@dagrejs/dagre` — graph construction,
`rankdir`, compound/cluster parentage, edge-label space, running the layout, and converting
dagre's center coordinates to top-left. `layoutGraph` (flowchart) becomes a thin adapter that
measures its labels and calls it, with byte-identical output for every existing flowchart.

## Why this ticket exists

Class diagrams are a directed graph, as are the state, ER, requirement and C4 diagrams on the
roadmap. Without this, each one re-does the same ~30 lines of dagre wiring. ADR-0001 already
frames dagre as an implementation detail behind our own seam; this makes that literally true by
giving it exactly one call site.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `layoutDirectedGraph(input)` positions a plain two-node, one-edge graph, returning per-node
  top-left `x`/`y` plus `width`/`height`, per-edge `points`, and the graph's `width`/`height`.
- [ ] Given an edge with a label `width`/`height`, the result carries a label anchor point for
  that edge and the layout reserves room for it (the ranks separate more than with no label).
- [ ] Given nodes with a `parentId` referring to a cluster node, the result carries a bounding box
  for the cluster that encloses every child's box.
- [ ] `rankdir` `TB`, `BT`, `LR` and `RL` each produce a distinguishable arrangement of the same
  input.
- [ ] Every existing `layoutGraph` test passes **unmodified**, and `layoutGraph` no longer imports
  dagre — `grep dagre packages/core/src/layout/layoutGraph.ts` finds nothing.
- [ ] The whole existing suite (flowchart, sequence, animation, renderer) passes unmodified: this
  ticket changes structure, not behavior. If a test has to change, stop and report — that means
  behavior moved.

## Test seam

`layoutDirectedGraph(input: DirectedGraphLayoutInput): DirectedGraphLayoutResult` — unit level,
pure function, real dagre (deterministic, per ADR-0001). `layoutGraph`'s existing tests act as
the regression harness for the migration.

Its input/output types live in this module, **not** `contracts.ts` — they are the interface
between two layout modules, not a cross-pipeline contract.

## Write ownership

- `packages/core/src/layout/layoutDirectedGraph.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/layout/layoutDirectedGraph.test.ts` (new)
- `packages/core/src/layout/layoutGraph.ts`
- `packages/core/src/layout/layoutGraph.test.ts` (expected to need **no** edits — listed only so
  the ownership map is honest if a test's imports must move)
